info.title: CoreLink Customer & Privacy REST API
info.summary: REST surface for CoreLink customer onboarding, privacy (DSR / DPA), billing webhooks, admin operations and health.
info.description:
Hand-authored OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the **non-REAPI** surface of CoreLink.
The high-volume CAS / AC / ByteStream / Capabilities surface is gRPC
(Remote Execution API v2) and documented separately under
`docs/reference/reapi/`.

Endpoint canonical paths are sourced from the implementing crates' doc-comments:
`corelink-signup`, `corelink-dpa-acceptance`, `corelink-dpa-versioning`,
`corelink-tier-selection`, `corelink-pat`, `corelink-dsr`,
`corelink-admin-api`,
`corelink-enterprise-inquiry`, plus `apps/server::webhook` (Stripe).

**Stability:** `v1` — public, semver-compatible. Breaking changes require a
new major path prefix (`/v2/...`).

/v1/signup.x-reconciliation-note:
Distinct intent from the SERVER-ONLY `/v1/signup/pilot/{token}`
(pilot-program HMAC-token redemption, axum-mounted in
`crates/corelink-container/src/routes/signup.rs`). The customer-
facing self-service signup endpoint is the one documented here;
`crates/corelink-signup` ships the orchestrator + atomic-
provisioning logic and the Worker terminates the route at the edge.

post.summary: Provision a new tenant from a verified Clerk identity.
post.description:
Idempotent signup orchestration. The orchestrator wraps tenant row +
DPA acceptance row + first PAT issuance in a single atomic D1
transaction (`INV-ONBOARD-ATOMIC-PROVISIONING`). Stripe customer
creation is a best-effort saga step — Stripe outage degrades to
`Deferred` with `billing_intent="deferred"`; the tenant is still
provisioned and signed up.

Request body intentionally has **no PAT field** (`CTRL-CRED-001`);
the first PAT is returned in the response (shown-once token).

202.description: Tenant provisioned, billing deferred (Stripe outage / chaos).

503.description: Transient backend outage (Stripe or D1); safe to retry with same `Idempotency-Key`.

post.summary: Record click-through acceptance of the current DPA version.
post.description:
Records the click-through consent proof for the caller's tenant and
returns the immutable audit reference for it. The tenant is taken from
the Clerk-authenticated session at the edge and is **never** read from
the body — a smuggled `tenant_id` is rejected (`400 bad_request`,
unknown fields are denied).

Idempotent on `(tenant, dpa_version)`: replaying an acceptance returns
the original `audit_event_id` unchanged, with the same `200`.

`dpa_version` must equal the server's current DPA version; an older
one is rejected with `400 dpa_version_mismatch`. `dpa_locale` must be
inside the closed GA locale set (`en-US` / `pt-BR` / `es-419`, and
their bare-language forms); anything else — `de` included — is
`400 unsupported_locale`.

`INV-ONBOARD-DPA-FIRST`: `/v1/onboarding/tier-select` stays locked
until an acceptance row exists for the tenant.

200.description:
Acceptance recorded — or replayed unchanged, which returns the same
body as the original acceptance.

400.description:
`bad_request` (malformed JSON, unknown field, malformed notice
hash), `unsupported_locale`, or `dpa_version_mismatch`.

401.description:
`unauthenticated` (edge internal-auth failed) or
`no_verified_tenant` (no tenant bound to the session).

500.description:
`internal` — durable-store or receipt-signing failure. Fail-CLOSED:
never reported as "already accepted".

post.summary: Select a subscription tier and receive a Stripe Checkout session URL.
post.description:
Enforces `INV-ONBOARD-DPA-FIRST` via a D1 lock — tier selection is
rejected until a DPA acceptance row exists for the tenant.
Returns a Stripe Checkout session URL; final activation happens
when the corresponding `checkout.session.completed` event lands
on `/v1/billing/stripe-webhook`.
A tenant may have only one payable checkout in flight. Repeating the
request is idempotent for that tenant; a second paid subscription is
rejected rather than replacing the existing billing owner.

403.description: DPA-first lock — caller must accept current DPA before selecting a tier.

get.summary: List the tenant's Personal Access Tokens (metadata only).
get.description:
Returns PAT metadata plus the tenant's BYOK status. No raw token
material is ever returned here.

Requires a cache-**write** capability: enumerating a tenant's
credentials is an admin operation, so a read-only (`cas:r`) token is
rejected with `403`.

200.description: PAT list (metadata only) and BYOK status.

post.summary: Issue a new Personal Access Token.
post.description:
Returns the raw token material **once**, in the `token` field. The
token is hashed before storage; every subsequent read returns metadata
only.

Minting a credential that carries any write/admin scope requires the
caller to already hold a cache-write capability — a read-only token
cannot bootstrap a write token for itself (`403`).

201.description: PAT issued. `token` is shown exactly once.

post.summary: Revoke a Personal Access Token by id.
post.description:
Revocation is a destructive tenant-admin operation. It requires the
server-trusted `owner` or `admin` team role from a Clerk dashboard
session; cache-write scope alone is not sufficient. An owner may
revoke any PAT in the tenant. An admin may revoke member PATs but is
rejected with `403` for the owner's PAT. Members, viewers, native PAT
callers, and cross-tenant targets are rejected (the latter as `404`).
Subsequent uses of the revoked token MUST fail closed
(`INV-PAT-REVOKE-PROPAGATION`).

200.description: Revoked. Returns the PAT metadata with `revoked_at` set.

post.summary: Create a one-time cryptographic team invitation.

201.description: Invitation created. The token is shown exactly once.

post.summary: Redeem a team invitation for the verified Clerk user.
post.description:
Requires the authenticated user's Clerk primary email to be explicitly
marked `verified`. The opaque token is tenant-bound by its stored
digest; no tenant id is accepted from the caller. The expiry check,
audit event and one-row status transition are atomic, so replay fails.

post.summary: Request deletion of the authenticated tenant account.
post.description:
Requests GDPR/LGPD erasure of the caller's whole tenant account. This
irreversible operation is restricted to the tenant owner using a
Clerk-authenticated dashboard session; a cache PAT is rejected.

The request is durably anchored and queued before acknowledgement. A
repeated request is safe and returns the same accepted outcome. The
response does not claim that erasure has completed: it only confirms
that the erasure workflow was accepted (`erasure_requested`) or that
no account remained (`no_account`).

202.description: Erasure request accepted or idempotent no-account acknowledgement.

503.description: Erasure worker is not configured; no acknowledgement was emitted.

post.summary: Export the authenticated tenant's portability bundle.
post.description:
Streams the complete tenant portability bundle as bounded,
content-addressed NDJSON: governance records first, then CAS/AC blob
bytes, followed by a manifest. Only an owner/admin with a dashboard
session or a write-capable PAT may invoke it; read-only cache tokens are
rejected because the bundle contains team PII, DPA/audit records and
all tenant blobs.

The export is rate-limited and an audit record is durably written before
the first byte is disclosed. A source or audit failure returns a 5xx
before streaming begins; the `x-corelink-export-schema` header is
`corelink.tenant_export.v1`.

200.description: Portability bundle streamed as newline-delimited JSON.

503.description: Export source is not configured or temporarily unavailable.

/v1/pats.x-reconciliation-note:
Compatibility alias for `POST /v1/customer/keys`. Both routes use the
same customer-plane issuance handler and the same Clerk/PAT auth gates.
New integrations should use `/v1/customer/keys`; this alias remains
documented while existing clients migrate so a served route is never
silently omitted from the published contract.

post.summary: Issue a Personal Access Token (compatibility alias).

201.description: PAT issued. `token` is shown exactly once.

post.summary: Receive a Stripe webhook event (HMAC-SHA256 signature required).
post.description:
Implemented at `apps/server::webhook::stripe_webhook_handler`.
Validates the `Stripe-Signature` header (5-minute replay window),
deduplicates on `event.id`, then dispatches to the subscription
handler. Unknown / out-of-scope event types are acknowledged with
200 OK (fire-and-forget contract).

**NOT secured by BearerPAT / Clerk** — see `StripeSignature` scheme.

200.description: Event accepted (including idempotent replays and acknowledged unknown event types).

400.description: Missing or invalid signature, or malformed event body.

500.description: Transient backend error; Stripe will retry.

/v1/privacy/dsr/{action}.x-reconciliation-note:
Mounted as six enumerated literals (`/access`, `/portability`,
`/rectification`, `/erasure`, `/restriction`, `/objection`) rather than
one templated segment — an `{action}` outside that closed set is a 404,
not a validation error.

post.summary: Submit a Data Subject Request (GDPR / LGPD / CCPA).
post.description:
6 supported actions per `corelink-dsr::event::DsrRequestKind`:
`access`, `portability`, `rectification`, `erasure`, `restriction`,
`objection`. Destructive arms (`erasure`, `rectification`) require
a fresh MFA step-up token via `X-MFA-Step-Up-Token`.

Returns an RS256-signed JWT receipt (90-day validity) on
acceptance. SLA deadline is jurisdiction-bound (GDPR 30d / LGPD
15d / CCPA 45d).

403.description: MFA step-up required (destructive arm) or token expired.

get.summary: Poll the status of a previously submitted DSR.

/v1/users/me.x-reconciliation-note:
Live in production. Returns the PAT-resolved caller identity that the
Worker injected via `x-corelink-tenant-id`, `x-corelink-token-prefix`,
`x-corelink-route-kind` headers before proxying to the Durable Object.
PATCH is NOT wired — `users.rs` registers only GET.

get.summary: Reflect the authenticated caller's PAT identity.
get.description:
Returns the PAT-resolved identity injected by the Worker into three
trusted headers. Clients call this to verify their PAT is wired
correctly without exercising the CAS/AC data plane. The raw PAT is
never reflected.

tenant_id.description: PAT-resolved tenant UUID (or `_unknown` if header absent).

token_prefix.description: Token prefix for audit correlation (NOT the raw PAT secret).

/api/health.x-reconciliation-note:
Terminated at the edge by the Worker — it never reaches the container.
Not to be confused with the adapter-host pip server's own `/healthz`
(that is the pip-adapter port, not the customer API surface), nor with
the container's `/_health`, which is documented separately.

post.summary: Redeem an HMAC-signed pilot signup token.
post.description:
Server-only route (axum-mounted). Token format
`pilot_<env>_<unix_ms>_<16-hex-random>.<hmac-hex>` verified in
constant time via `subtle::ConstantTimeEq`. TTL 14 days from mint.
Rate-limited 5/IP/hour. Audit-emit fail-CLOSED per
`INV-AUDIT-EMIT-ATOMIC-WITH-HANDLER`.

201.description: Pilot tenant reserved; activation URL returned.

503.description: Audit pipeline or signup store unavailable (fail-CLOSED).

get.summary: Admin-plane read of a typed resource.
get.description:
End-to-end wire-up of `corelink_handler_admin::AdminReadHandler`
against an `Arc<dyn ...>` trait-object route state. Emits
`Sli::AvailControlPlane` per route entry.

post.summary: Admin-plane mutate (dual-approval-gated).
post.description:
`AdminMutateHandler` enforces (1) RBAC (initiator must hold admin
role), (2) dual-approval token presence, (3) approver ≠ initiator.
Each path emits the corresponding `MutateAttempted` /
`MutateDenied` / `MutateDualApprovalRejected` audit row BEFORE
the response (audit-emit-BEFORE-handler atomicity).

get.summary: List pilot tenants filtered by lifecycle state.
get.description:
Replaces the wave-27 `list-pilot-tenants.sh` shell script.
Auth: Clerk JWT with scope `corelink:admin:pilots`; the route
re-checks the scope at the boundary (5-Layer Defense).

post.summary: Grant pilot tier and cap.
post.description:
Replaces the wave-27 `grant-pilot-tier.sh` shell script.
Transitions `pilot_state` NEW → ACTIVE atomically with
`tier_granted_at_ms` set.

post.summary: Run the 24-hour activation check-in.
post.description:
Replaces the wave-27 `pilot-24h-checkin.sh` shell script.
Emits an alert audit row when the tenant has not uploaded a single
blob 24h after `tier_granted_at_ms`.

get.summary: Stream a bulk audit-chain export from R2.
get.description:
Streams the per-tenant audit chain over the supplied `[from, to)`
window. Window bounds accept either ISO 8601 UTC
(`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`) or raw Unix epoch milliseconds. Cross-
tenant attempts emit a security audit row BEFORE the 403.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO 8601 UTC or Unix ms).

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description:
The tenant whose chain is exported. When it differs from the
authenticated principal's tenant, the route emits a cross-tenant
attempt audit row and returns 403.

X-Chain-Head-Anchor.description: Hex BLAKE3 hash anchor for client verification.

get.summary: Event-type count aggregates over a time window.

200.description: Aggregated counts grouped by event type.

get.summary: Event-count timeline bucketed at a chosen granularity.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description:
Bucket size in milliseconds (capped at 24h). Default chosen by
the handler to keep `(to - from) / granularity ≤ 1000`.

post.summary: Write multiple CAS blobs with length-framed upload.

requestBody.description:
Length-framed upload: newline-delimited JSON manifest entries
(`{"hash":"<blake3>","len":<bytes>}`), one blank line, then
the concatenated raw object bytes in manifest order. The manifest
and payload together are capped at 10 MiB; object bytes at 8 MiB
and 2,000 objects.

200.description: Per-object outcomes in manifest order; one bad object does not abort the batch.

post.summary: Read multiple CAS blobs with bounded, ordered framing.

200.description: Ordered manifest lines, a blank-line terminator, then concatenated blob bytes.

post.summary: Probe existence of multiple CAS blobs without returning bytes.

200.description: Existence results in request order; object bytes are never included.

/v1/cas/{tenant}/{hash}.x-binding-note:
Backed by R2 storage in production (falls back to InMemory when creds
absent). Cross-tenant denials are enforced at the route boundary and
emit audit rows before the 403. Route constant:
`CAS_READ_ROUTE = "/v1/cas/:tenant/:hash"`.

get.summary: Read a CAS blob by `(tenant, content-hash)`.

403.description: Cross-tenant attempt — audit row emitted before 403.

put.summary: Write a CAS blob by `(tenant, content-hash)`.

schema.description: Hex BLAKE3 digest the caller claims for this body.

requestBody.description: Raw blob bytes, capped at 64 MiB by the shared cache-entry limit. The handler verifies the hash against the path parameter before committing.

201.description: Blob stored (durable commit). Body echoes the content hash.

200.description: Idempotent re-write — blob already existed with identical hash.

422.description: Hash mismatch — body bytes do not match the claimed digest.

/v1/cas/{digest}.x-binding-note:
REAPI read-only binary (`corelink-reapi::http_read`) — distinct
listener from the container surface. Exposes the same intent as
`/v1/cas/{tenant}/{hash}` but addresses blobs by canonical digest
and resolves the tenant via auth context rather than path.

get.summary: Read a CAS blob by canonical digest (REAPI binary).

/v1/ac/{tenant}/{action_digest}.x-binding-note:
REAPI HTTP fake for the Action Cache — production AC traffic uses
the gRPC ActionCache service. Cross-tenant denials emit
`AuditEventKind::LookupDenied` / `UpdateDenied` BEFORE the 403.

get.summary: Look up an Action Cache result.

schema.description: Hex digest of the action's `ActionResult` key.

201.description: Stored durably (fresh insert). Body echoes the action digest.

403.description: Cross-tenant attempt — audit row emitted before 403.

/_health.x-reconciliation-note:
Mounted directly in main.rs as `.route("/_health", get(health_handler))`.
Used by the Cloudflare Durable Object `waitForContainerHealth` probe
(expects HTTP 200 + application/json) and by `scripts/smoke-prod-corelink.sh`.
Returns `{"status":"ok"}` — no storage field yet (A4 may add it).

get.summary: Container liveness / readiness probe for the DO health check.

post.summary: Accept-and-drop Turborepo telemetry events.
Static remote-cache enabled check (Turbo status probe).

/v8/artifacts/{hash}.x-reconciliation-note:
Route constants `TURBO_GET_ROUTE`/`TURBO_PUT_ROUTE` = `/v8/artifacts/:hash`.
Query parameter `teamId` is **required**; must match the authenticated
caller's tenant (cross-tenant guard). `slug` is optional/informational.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Vercel team identifier — used as the storage partition key.

403.description: Cross-tenant attempt (teamId does not match authenticated tenant).

200.description: Artifact stored. Body is `{"urls":["..."]}` per Vercel spec.

/bazel/v2/{instance}/blobs/{hash}/{size}.x-reconciliation-note:
Axum resolves `/blobs/ac/:hash/:size` before `/blobs/:hash/:size`
because the literal `ac` segment wins the matchit priority.
Tenant is resolved from the `:instance` path segment (treated as
the storage partition key); cross-tenant guard enforced.

get.summary: Read a CAS blob (Bazel REAPI ByteStream GET).

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Bazel instance name (used as tenant partition key).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Expected blob size in bytes (REAPI digest component).

put.summary: Write a CAS blob (Bazel REAPI ByteStream PUT).

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Upload UUID (REAPI upload id, used for dedup).

get.summary: Read an Action Cache result (Bazel REAPI AC GET).

put.summary: Write an Action Cache result (Bazel REAPI AC PUT).

post.summary: Find missing blobs (Bazel REAPI FindMissingBlobs POST).

200.description: List of digests not present in the cache.

BearerPAT.description:
`Authorization: Bearer <PAT>` where PAT is a 32-byte UUIDv7-derived
opaque token (BLAKE3-keyed hash in DB). Tier 1 of the canonical
auth ladder per `corelink-pat`. Scopes encoded in PAT row.

ClerkSessionCookie.name: __session
ClerkSessionCookie.description: Clerk browser session cookie (alternative to PAT for the web onboarding flow).

StripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
StripeSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature; verified by `apps/server::webhook::stripe_webhook_handler` against the secret in `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` env var with a 5-minute replay window.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency token. Same key replays the original response (no duplicate provisioning).

AdminOperationReason.name: X-Admin-Operation-Reason
AdminOperationReason.description: Free-text justification recorded in the audit envelope for every admin mutation. Required for all `/v1/admin/*` write endpoints.

BatchTooLarge.description: Batch exceeds the 2,000-object or 8 MiB object-byte limit, or the 10 MiB request-body limit.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Content-Type is not accepted by this batch route.

InternalError.description: Server error. Safe to retry idempotent operations.

BatchUploadBody.description:
Length-framed CAS upload body. The manifest is NDJSON with `hash` and
`len` fields, followed by one blank line and the concatenated raw
object bytes. The body is capped at 10 MiB; declared object bytes are
capped at 8 MiB and 2,000 objects.

BatchHashNdjsonBody.description: NDJSON body containing `{"hash":"<blake3>"}` lines, at most 2,000 lines.

hash.description: Echo of the manifest hash claim.

error.description: Compact per-object failure reason; null for created or exists.

present.description: True only when the storage existence probe found the blob.

CustomerPat.description:
One PAT row as returned by the `/v1/customer/keys` family. Metadata
only — raw token material appears exactly once, in
`CustomerKeyCreateResponse.token`, and never again.

last_used_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last use; `null` if never used.

CustomerByokStatus.description: BYOK posture for the tenant, returned alongside the PAT list.

last_rotated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last rotation, when present.

name.description: Human-readable name for the new PAT.

scopes.description:
Scopes to grant. Requesting any write/admin scope requires the
caller to already hold a cache-write capability.

token.description:
Raw bearer token. Shown **once**; it is hashed before storage and
is not recoverable afterwards.

invitation_token.description: One-time opaque capability; never returned by list.

status.description: Accepted for asynchronous erasure, or idempotent no-account acknowledgement.

DpaAcceptRequest.description:
Unknown fields are rejected (`400 bad_request`) — in particular a
smuggled `tenant_id`, which is header-bound at the edge and never read
from the body.

dpa_version.description:
DPA template version accepted. Must equal the server's current
version, else `400 dpa_version_mismatch`.

dpa_locale.description:
UI locale. Closed GA set — anything outside it (`de` included) is
`400 unsupported_locale`.

notice_text_hash.description: Client-computed SHA-256 (hex64) of the rendered notice text.

ui_capture_ts.description:
Client-captured click timestamp (ms since epoch). Optional for
older clients; when absent the server uses its own time.

dpa_accepted_at.description: Acceptance time (ms since epoch, as a string).

DpaAcceptError.description:
The DPA-accept route returns this bare envelope, NOT the shared
`ErrorEnvelope`.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code from the canonical error taxonomy (`error_taxonomy.md`).

message.description: Human-readable explanation (locale-neutral; do NOT echo back PII).

request_id.description: Server-assigned request id for support correlation.

clerk_event_id.description: Clerk webhook event id (idempotency anchor at the identity provider).

email_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of normalized email. **Raw email is NEVER transmitted to the server** (CTRL-PRIV-001).

notice_text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the notice text the user saw.

PatMetadata.description:
PAT metadata as returned by the **signup** flow (`/v1/signup`). This is
NOT the shape of the `/v1/customer/keys` family — that surface returns
`CustomerPat`, whose field names differ (`name`/`created_at` rather
than `label`/`created_at_ms`, and no `prefix`).

prefix.description: First 8 chars of the raw token (display only).

StripeWebhookEnvelope.description: The Stripe-shaped event envelope; only fields the handler reads are typed here.

request_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the rectification / portability payload (when applicable). Used as part of the idempotency 4-tuple.

primary_contact_email_hash.description: SHA-256 hex; raw email NOT exposed.

Bcp47Locale.description: BCP-47 locale (Lote 10.16 canonical 3-locale set currently — en-US, pt-BR, fr-FR).

PrimaryRegion.description: 3-region canonical map per `corelink-region` / Lote 10.16 locale→region binding.

PilotSignupRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /v1/signup/pilot/{token}`. All four fields
are required; each is capped at 256 chars
(`MAX_FIELD_LEN` in `crates/corelink-container/src/routes/signup.rs`).

tenant_id.description: UUIDv7 assigned to the reserved pilot tenant.

activation_url.description: Where the applicant completes account creation. Points at the live Clerk sign-up surface, carrying the reservation id as the `pilot` query parameter.

approval_id.description:
Dual-approval ledger id (omit = rejected — handler emits
`MutateDualApprovalRejected` BEFORE the 403).

approver.description: Second approver principal (must differ from initiator).
